sections.appearance: She has long, silver hair. Her eyes are pink which fade into blue. Her hair is decorated with various purple floral accessories and a black ribbon. Halo ==== Azusa's halo thematically takes after a woven laurel, portrayed as a yellow unclosed circle that resembles a crescent moon with various olive leaves. Uniform ==== Azusa wears a collared white shirt and a long, black dress overtop with frills and flowers, and wears white-and-grey striped panties. She wears white-pointed shoes and black, cuffed socks. sections.personality: A cold person at the core, much of Azusa's aloof nature stems from her training under Arius and being raised as a weapon. Because of her dedication to the mission, she has no hobbies or any interests and does not make any attempts to befriend her classmates in the Supplementary Lessons Department. The training made her extremely adept at combat, having extensive knowledge on how to kill the other students by destroying their halos and lives a spartan lifestyle, focusing on her missions and studies ahead. Through her experiences in the Supplementary Lessons Department in the events of Treaty of Eden, she learns to enjoy life and find purpose in her actions, striking a friendship with Ajitani Hifumi and Sensei as a result. However, she still has an emotional conflict between her loyalty towards her former squad and the necessity of having to kill them to prevent Trinity and to a lesser extent Kivotos from falling into ruin.
